_comment: Example configuration - Run 'python setup.py' for interactive setup, or copy this file to config.json and customize. config.json is gitignored: each machine carries its own. Run 'python main.py doctor' on each machine to see how it resolves. Paths support ~ and $VARS.
_log_file_doc: Optional. Defaults to mp3_service.log beside this config file.
_rekordbox_xml_path_doc: Optional. Absolute path to the Rekordbox XML file processed tracks should be appended to. Configure the same path in Rekordbox > Preferences > Advanced > rekordbox xml > Imported Library. Leave unset to disable sync.
_external_watch_doc: External drive watcher: registers new audio files appearing on an external drive in the same Rekordbox XML. First scan baselines existing files without registering them — only files that appear AFTER the baseline are registered. Point this at the DJ-track archive (the ssd_archive_path dir), NOT the whole drive — pointing it at a drive that also holds a sample library will sweep tens of thousands of one-shots/loops into Rekordbox.
_external_max_new_per_scan_doc: Anti-flood cap. If one scan finds more than this many new files it re-baselines instead of registering (a reorg changes every path, the watcher's identity key). 0 disables.
_ssd_archive_doc: Optional. When set AND the volume is mounted, processed tracks are moved here from local_path. Path must live under /Volumes/<drive>/... so liveness can be checked. When the volume is absent the converted AIFF stays in local_path and is moved across by reconcile() once the drive returns - it is never discarded. Leave empty on a machine with no archive drive.
_keep_flac_sources_doc: Keep the source FLAC after its AIFF reaches its final destination. Default true. Set false ONLY on a machine whose ssd_archive_path is a real archive drive, since a 16/44.1 AIFF does not replace a 24/96 FLAC. This is deliberately independent of ssd_archive_path: an SSD that is merely unplugged must not change whether originals are deleted.
